reason: A better targets the high-temperature/oxidative wear regime with a measurable tribo-oxide mediator, controlled compositional change, expected wear/friction response, and explicit environmental boundary. Its proposal still needs stronger controls for composition-induced hardness changes and evidence that the Cr- or Al-rich oxide is genuinely self-lubricating, whereas B relies largely on a correlative Hn/Er metric and interventions that confound composition, microstructure, and wear mechanism.
